- Primary hypothesis (rich-positive extreme basis predicts higher crash incidence/severity at fixed anchor) is not supported after multiplicity correction. Grid shows some Holm-significant hits but with strong dependence/confounding caveats; no effect claimed. All exclusions and statuses preserved.
